Description

Ashmole Primary School offers well-maintained classrooms available to hire for a wide range of educational, community, and professional activities. Located in Greater London, these versatile spaces are ideal for tutoring, training courses, workshops, meetings, language classes, arts and crafts, and children's activities.

Each classroom provides a comfortable learning environment with flexible seating arrangements to suit different group sizes and event types. Whether you're running a regular class or hosting a one-off session, the classrooms offer a practical and welcoming space.

Conveniently located and suitable for both daytime and evening hire (subject to availability), Ashmole Primary School's classrooms provide an excellent venue for local organisations, businesses, and community groups looking for affordable, accessible indoor space.
